senses.gloss: ch. same, to fall down, go down.
units: <cite ref="Bava Kamma 92b:7">B. Kam. 92ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Megillah 14b:4">Meg. 14ᵇ</cite> (prov.) <he>שפיל ואזיל בר אווזא וכ׳</he> the duck bends its head down in walking, and its eyes look all around (it follows two pursuits at the same time, v. <cite ref="Q01073"><he>פִּלְכָא</he></cite>).
<cite ref="Berakhot 10a:6">Ber. 10ᵃ</cite> <he>שְׁפִיל לסיפיה דקרא</he> go to the end of the verse (in order to understand the whole of it); a. fr.
<cite ref="Targum Jerusalem, Leviticus 10:20">Targ. Y. II, Lev. X, 20</cite>.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Proverbs 25:7">Targ. Prov. XXV, 7</cite>.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Proverbs 29:23">Ib. XXIX, 23</cite>; a. fr.
<cite ref="Yevamot 121a:13">Yeb. 121ᵃ</cite> <he>גלי אַשְׁפְּלוּ</he> the waves may have carried (and landed him).
